fullPassage: Language has the power to shape our attitudes and behaviors. Inclusive language serves as an important tool for acknowledging diversity, encouraging sensitivity to differences, and promoting equal opportunities. It actively contributes to breaking biases and discriminatory language and to building a welcoming environment of inclusivity. For example, adopting the gender-neutral term "mail carrier" instead of "mailman" or "mailwoman" conveys a powerful message: it recognizes the capabilities of individuals of either gender for delivering the mail. This seemingly minor change reflects a more extensive commitment to acknowledging the ability of every person, regardless of his or her gender. Another aspect of inclusive communication, known as person-first language, encourages us to prioritize the individual over any defining characteristic. Instead of saying "colored people," we should use "people of color." Similarly, opting for "person with blindness" over "blind person" highlights the unique identity and dignity of each individual while avoiding the reduction of a person to an unusual characteristic. In summary, inclusive language plays a crucial role in creating a fair and welcoming society, where every individual can embrace his or her genuine self without the fear of exclusion.

시각 장애가 있는 사람을 가리킬 때 사람을 앞세우는 표현은 개인을 특이한 특성으로 축소하는 것을 피하며 고유한 정체성을 부각한다.
포용적 언어는 배제의 두려움을 키우는 역할을 한다.

questions.passage: For example, adopting the gender-neutral term "mail carrier" instead of "mailman" or "mailwoman" conveys a powerful message: it ①<u>recognize the capabilities</u> of individuals of either gender for delivering the mail.  This seemingly minor change ②<u>reflects a more extensive commitment</u> to acknowledging the ability of every person, regardless of his or her gender.  Another aspect of inclusive communication, known as person-first language, ③<u>encourages us to prioritize</u> the individual over any defining characteristic.  Instead of saying "colored people," we ④<u>should use</u> "people of color.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ① recognize → recognizes: 주어 it(=성 중립 표현 채택)이 단수이므로 단수 동사 recognizes를 쓴다
det.analysis:
❌ ① recognize the capabilities → 여기가 정답(틀린 곳)! 'conveys a powerful message: it recognizes ~'에서 주어 it은 단수예요. 단수 주어에는 단수 동사 recognizes를 써야 하는데 복수형 recognize로 써서 틀렸어요. ←정답

✅ ② reflects a more extensive commitment: 단수 주어 change에 reflects가 맞아요.

✅ ③ encourages us to prioritize: 단수 주어 aspect에 encourages, 'encourage+목적어+to부정사' 구조라 맞아요.

✅ ④ should use: 'we should use' — 조동사 should 뒤 동사원형 use가 맞아요.
det.tip: 단수 주어(it) → 단수 동사 recognizes

questions.passage: Language has the power to shape our attitudes and behaviors.  Inclusive language serves as an important tool for acknowledging diversity, encouraging sensitivity to differences, and promoting equal opportunities.  It actively contributes to breaking biases and discriminatory language and to building a welcoming environment of inclusivity.  For example, adopting the gender-neutral term "mail carrier" instead of "mailman" or "mailwoman" conveys a powerful message: it recognizes the capabilities of individuals of either gender for delivering the mail.  This seemingly minor change reflects a more extensive commitment to acknowledging the ability of every person, regardless of his or her gender.
questions.stem: 위 글에서, 'mailman'이나 'mailwoman' 대신 사용하도록 제시된 성 중립적 표현을 본문에서 찾아 쓰시오. (2단어, 영어로)

det.korean: 정답: mail carrier (우편 집배원)
det.analysis: 원문 'adopting the gender-neutral term "mail carrier" instead of "mailman" or "mailwoman"'에서 확인할 수 있어요. 'mailman'·'mailwoman' 대신 쓰는 성 중립적 표현은 'mail carrier'예요.
det.tip: gender-neutral term "mail carrier" instead of "mailman" or "mailwoman"

questions.passage: This seemingly minor change reflects a more extensive commitment to acknowledging the ability of every person, regardless of his or her gender.  Another aspect of inclusive communication, known as person-first language, encourages us to prioritize the individual over any defining characteristic.  Instead of saying "colored people," we should use "people of color. " Similarly, opting for "person with blindness" over "blind person" highlights the unique identity and dignity of each individual while avoiding the reduction of a person to an unusual characteristic.  In summary, inclusive language plays a crucial role in creating a fair and welcoming society, where every individual can embrace his or her genuine self without the fear of exclusion.

det.tip: Instead of "colored people" → "people of color"

questions.stem: 다음 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ② 포용적 언어는 다양성을 촉진하고 각 개인을 존중하여 공정하고 환영하는 사회를 만드는 데 도움을 준다
det.analysis:
글은 포용적 언어가 다양성을 인정하고(acknowledging diversity) 개인의 고유한 정체성과 존엄성을 존중해 공정하고 환영하는 사회를 만든다고 말해요.

❌ ① Gender-neutral job titles should replace every traditional word ~(성 중립 직함이 모든 전통 단어를 대체해야 한다): 지나친 일반화로, 글의 요지가 아니에요.

✅ ② Inclusive language promotes diversity and respects each individual, helping build a fair and welcoming society.(포용적 언어는 다양성을 촉진하고 각 개인을 존중하여 공정하고 환영하는 사회를 만드는 데 도움을 준다): 글의 요지와 일치해요. ←정답

❌ ③ Person-first language matters far more than any other form ~(사람 우선 언어가 다른 어떤 소통보다 훨씬 중요하다): 본문에 없는 과장이에요.

❌ ④ Changing just a few words has little real effect ~(단어 몇 개를 바꾸는 것은 거의 효과가 없다): 글은 작은 변화가 큰 의미를 지닌다고 했으므로 반대예요.
